intro: Release notes are published from 1.2.13 onward. Earlier 1.2 updates, summarized: Command Center learned to update itself; Return Tasks gained an All checkbox; the Work Items modal became fully keyboard driven; work item detail tabs and the quick filter arrived; the Update button got louder when an update is waiting; tasks can be closed from the dashboard; and the comment, CalcEngine History and Site Scope dialogs received a round of fixes, including the comment modal's input order and default assignee.

releases.theme: Work item links open in your browser
Help that opens where you need it, Work Items that keep up with you, and CalcEngine history you can trust
KAT Command Center is now as beautiful as it is functional.
